name: Foreign buyer with opaque BO structure
description: Buyer is a corporate entity from a high-risk or low-transparency jurisdiction. UBO cannot be verified to a natural person.

name: Cash deposit at signing exceeding threshold
description: Cash deposit at contract exceeds AMLR / national threshold; CDD trigger missed.

name: PEP buyer / seller undisclosed
description: Buyer or seller is a PEP and EDD not performed.

name: Sanctioned individual using nominee buyer
description: True UBO is sanctioned; transaction completed via nominee that screens clean.

name: Source-of-funds inadequately evidenced
description: High-value sale completed without robust SoF documentation.

name: Buyer-impersonation deposit fraud
description: Attacker intercepts client correspondence and re-routes deposit.

name: Letting ≥€10k/month — obliged-entity trigger
description: Letting arrangement crosses the €10k/month threshold (AMLR letting-agent trigger).

name: Kickback from mortgage broker / lender
description: Agent receives undisclosed kickback for client referrals.
